scope: Case-specific authored reference renderer. Cards and status come from the same writer inputs. No language-model generations or generic prose-quality claim.

records.memo:
Workshop status: IMPASSE
The first delegate accepts only review. The second delegate accepts only closure. These exclusive positions are incompatible. The chair should refer review and closure back to the delegates for another workshop round.
S/2023/638 was not adopted after Russia's permanent-member veto (13–1–1). Separate draft S/2023/639 fell short of affirmative votes (1–1–13). The workshop cannot change either official vote.

historical_evidence.status-638: France and the United Arab Emirates submitted S/2023/638. It proposed renewing the sanctions and extending the Panel of Experts. The tally was 13 in favour, 1 against and 1 abstention. Russia cast the sole negative vote and the draft was not adopted due to the negative vote of a permanent member. France supported it and China abstained.
historical_evidence.status-639: Russia submitted S/2023/639 as a separate draft. It proposed a final extension of the sanctions and immediate dissolution of the Panel of Experts. Russia voted in favour, Japan against and all other members including France and China abstained. It was not adopted, having received 1 vote in favour, 1 against and 13 abstentions.

records.memo:
Workshop status: EARLY
The UN office can attend only early. The liaison office can attend both slots. Early is their sole overlap, so the chair should propose an early briefing.
Resolution 2669 requests the Secretary-General or his Special Envoy, in coordination with the ASEAN Special Envoy, to report orally to the Security Council by 15 March 2023 on UN support for the Five-Point Consensus. The workshop has no authority to change that duty.

historical_evidence.chair: India held the Council presidency. The President called the vote and announced adoption. India's representative later explained the national abstention, then resumed the duties of President.
historical_evidence.mandate: Resolution 2669 demands an immediate end to violence, calls for humanitarian access, and acknowledges ASEAN's central role. It requests the Secretary-General or his Special Envoy, in coordination with the ASEAN Special Envoy, to report orally to the Security Council by 15 March 2023 on UN support for the Five-Point Consensus.
